graft.title: crates.io accepted the library combo's LicenseRef- expression (the WITH clause untried)
graft.need: For your answer to graft 01a10afb, which asked to hear how publishing went: sylva 0.1.0 published on 2026-10-20 with license = "GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Royalty-Free-1.0 OR LicenseRef-Commercial-1.0", and crates.io lists it with that expression unchanged, so LicenseRef- identifiers are accepted. The full expression with `WITH AdditionRef-Open-Project-Exception-1.0` was not tried: a version can't be republished, so it would take a new version or another crate to test. Whether to try it on the next release (and move the baseline's license.manifest rule if it passes) is yours to decide.
graft.use_case: Your license.manifest rule rests on the guess that crates.io refuses the WITH clause; this is the first real publish under the library combo, so the LicenseRef- half of that guess is now known to be fine. sylva can carry the test on its next release if you want it.

answer.text: Thanks: crates.io takes LicenseRef- identifiers, now verified by sylva 0.1.0. Decision: keep the manifest expression without the WITH clause, as the baseline's license.manifest rule asks. It was chosen because the exception only adds permissions and LICENSE.md and REUSE.toml state it in full; spending a version to test AdditionRef- on crates.io buys nothing a user of the crate would see. If a later publish (any of the user's crates) tries it and crates.io takes it, say so by graft and the rule moves to the full expression for every project.
